Software for simulating collective quantum dynamics, with code and data from individual papers.

::: {.code-project}
[JULIA · NUMERICAL METHODS]{.eyebrow}

## ShiftedGMRES.jl

Compute a frequency sweep by solving shifted linear systems with a shared Krylov basis. The examples cover a sparse matrix and the forward scattering from two coupled dipoles.

[Examples and download](shifted-gmres.qmd){.text-link}
:::

::: {.code-project}
[JULIA · OPEN QUANTUM SYSTEMS]{.eyebrow}

## PIDicke.jl

Permutation-invariant open-system calculations for two-level emitters in the Dicke basis, including population dynamics, quantum trajectories, coherences, and spin–cavity models.

[Repository ↗](https://github.com/Nico0oblr/PiDicke.jl){.text-link} [Examples ↗](https://github.com/Nico0oblr/PiDicke.jl/tree/main/examples){.paper-link}
:::

::: {.code-project}
[JULIA · NUMERICAL METHODS]{.eyebrow}

## KrylovSolverMCWF

A Krylov-subspace approach to Monte Carlo wavefunction simulations with QuantumOptics.jl, with an example notebook.

[Repository ↗](https://github.com/Nico0oblr/KrylovSolverMCWF){.text-link}
:::

## Scaling theory of decoherence in Dicke superradiance

Julia simulations, numerical data, and plotting notebooks for the paper on local dephasing and spontaneous emission in Dicke superradiance.
